note:
Particles whose function_type is wrong, found by INTERSECTING two independent weak signals.

A first pass keyed only on the authored pt-BR prose returned 90 candidates, of which ~85 were the
audit's own false positives: the で of 台風で and the に of 高さに驚いた mark cause, but a cause-marking
で/に is 格助詞 -- `case` is correct and the prose agreeing on "causa" is not evidence of anything. An
earlier pass keyed only on the token shape was no better: "の is a modifier iff a nominal follows" drops
84 legitimate genitives to catch 5 pronominal の, and "が is a subject iff a nominal precedes" drops 51
legitimate subjects to catch 1 adversative.

Neither signal is usable alone. Their INTERSECTION is, because they fail independently: the prose is
free text written per sentence, the token shape is mechanical, and nothing causes them to be wrong in
the same place. A row here means the shape says one thing and a human writing about that exact particle
in that exact sentence said the same thing.

Emits candidates for review. Applies nothing.
